description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Wages Board on Pre School Service Trade, Glassware Manufacturing Trade, Beedi Manufacturing Trade
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the establishment and modification of minimum wage regulations under the Wages Boards Ordinance. It involves legal notifications that vary existing wage determinations, which falls under the category of legal/regulatory matters (new regulations, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements). While it mentions government officials like the Minister of Labour and the Commissioner of Labour, it does so in the context of their regulatory authority rather than detailing their personal appointments or specific portfolio responsibilities, making it a regulatory gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid type.
